UI_SurvivorBriefing_onArrival_tooltip: When a new survivor starts: a new game, a respawn, or a first join to a server.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onMidnight_tooltip: Once a day at the hour set below (midnight by default), while you are awake. Asleep at that hour, or woke up less than two hours before it? The briefing you get on waking counts instead.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_DailyHour_tooltip: The hour of the daily briefing on a 24-hour clock: 0 is midnight, 6 is 6 AM, 20 is 8 PM. The day number itself still changes at midnight.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_dailySunrise_tooltip: Shows the daily briefing at sunrise instead of at the hour above. Sunrise follows the game's seasons: earlier in summer, later in winter. If the world has no sunrise (Endless Day or Endless Night), the hour above is used.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onWake_tooltip: A moment after you wake up.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onLoadSave_tooltip: When you continue an existing character: loading a save or rejoining a server.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onResume_tooltip: When you close the pause menu and return to the game.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_onTown_tooltip: Shows the briefing when you walk or drive into a town or a named area such as the airport. Not again for the same place within 6 in-game hours, and not when you only skirt its edge.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_SectionWhat: What it shows (the day of survival is always shown)
UI_SurvivorBriefing_DayCounter_tooltip: Which day the big number counts. Your day of survival starts again at Day 1 for every new character, respawns included. The world day counts from the world's first day (the server's, in multiplayer). Both shows your day big and the world day as a line below.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_DayRule_tooltip: At midnight: the day you arrived is Day 1 and a new day starts every midnight, so the number can be ahead of the "Survived for" time on the character panel. Every 24 hours survived: Day 2 starts once you have survived 24 hours, in step with the character panel.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showTime_tooltip: The clock. It keeps running while the briefing is on screen.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showOutbreakDay_tool: Which day of the Knox Event it is. The outbreak began on July 4, 1993 (the in-game radio says so), so July 4 is day 1 and the usual start, July 9, is day 6. Not shown before July 4. With "Only what your character can know" on, it needs the date, like the Date line.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showName_tooltip: Your character's first and last name.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showLocation_tooltip: The town you are in or how far the nearest one is, and a nearby landmark.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showKills_tooltip: How many zombies this character has killed.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showBanditKills_tool: Only with the Bandits mod: the bandit kill count that mod keeps for your character.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_showDeaths_tooltip: How many characters you have lost in this world (on this server, in multiplayer). Counted from the day this option arrived, not before.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_realistic: Only what your character can know
UI_SurvivorBriefing_realistic_tooltip: Follows the same rule as the game's own clock. Without a watch on your wrist or a clock in your hand you only get the part of the day (Morning, Evening...). The date and the temperature need a digital one. A watch in a bag does not count. Past a hundred kills you only get a rough count.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Look_tooltip: How the briefing looks. Every look shows the lines you switch on above, at the position and text size set below (Emergency Broadcast becomes a full-width bar in the centre positions; Cinematic always uses the whole screen). To try them all on your own character, press "Preview the looks" below.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_PreviewLooks_tooltip: Opens the looks window as soon as you are back in the game: click a look to see it on your own character, and "Use these settings" keeps it.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu: Looks window in the right-click menu
UI_SurvivorBriefing_looksMenu_tooltip: Also puts "Survivor Briefing: test looks" in the menu you get by right-clicking in the world. Off by default: "Preview the looks" above opens the same window.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Duration_tooltip: How long the briefing stays once all its lines are in.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_Position_tooltip: Where the briefing appears. It keeps clear of the chat box, the icon bar, the speed buttons, the moodles and the hotbar. Size is set separately, under Text size.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_TextSize_tooltip: Follows the game's font size setting, one step smaller or larger.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_motion_tooltip: Lets the looks move: lines rise into place, letterbox bars slide in, text types out letter by letter. Off: everything fades in instead, which looks smooth at any UI frame rate. Stamps, stickers, flickers and blinking cursors happen either way.
UI_SurvivorBriefing_ShowKey_tooltip: Press to show the briefing now, press again to hide it. Unbound by default.
